# Third-party components

eCMPilot's original code is BSD-2-Clause. Third-party components keep their own licenses.

- Gradle Wrapper 9.4.1: original Gradle authors, Apache-2.0. Wrapper scripts preserve their original notices. Wrapper files use the same pinned upstream distribution/checksum as the local Android Dash toolchain.
- Gson 2.11.0: Google, Apache-2.0; https://github.com/google/gson.
- AndroidX / Jetpack Compose / Material 3: Android Open Source Project contributors, Apache-2.0.
- Kotlin and kotlinx.coroutines: JetBrains contributors, Apache-2.0.

The [Apache-2.0 license text](Apache-2.0.txt) is included. Build-time JUnit is EPL-1.0; its dependency is not packaged into the application. Android platform components are supplied by the operating system.
